The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a workstation used to forge ingots into usable parts and equipment, better anvils make operations require less energy and allow for the crafting of better equipment. As of the <i>Breaking Dead</i> DLC, an optional task queue has been added and a [[zombie]] can be stationed here.
